parsed.explanation: The combined regime is state criminalisation plus state-tolerated predation. Nationwide secular law carries 10–14 years for same-sex conduct; 12 northern provinces add death-penalty Zina provisions, and a foreign government's 2026 advisory warns LGBT+ travellers of that risk. Enforcement is documented as violent and predatory: police torture and arbitrary arrests under the 2016 finding, a 2025 beating and extortion for 'looking gay', mass hotel raids producing 57–100+ arrests, and long pretrial detentions. A trans woman's 2024 killing remains unprosecuted with official misgendering — impunity documented. Dating-app luring gangs weaponise outing; prison placement is discretionary with an unrecorded outcome; no legal protections exist. The only positives (a schools policy, a nominal health guarantee) are resident-facing and inoperative for a visitor. Worst feature: tier-1/tier-2 state exposure with no working remedy.

entry_documents.exposure: Documented: outed travellers face document/appearance scrutiny feeding police stops; a man was beaten and extorted for 'looking gay' (March 2025). No protections exist to stop disclosure or challenge it.
entry_documents.protection: Not documented. No evidence foreign documents, X markers, or mismatched presentation are safely handled.
entry_documents.interaction: Document check → suspicion of same-sex conduct → arrest/extortion under secular or Sharia provisions, escalating sharply in the 12 northern provinces.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented: police torture and arbitrary arrests under the 2016 report; mass raids (100+, 57, 67, 76 arrested, 2018–2023); multi-year pretrial jail; extortion for release. Death penalty for male sodomy in 12 northern provinces.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. A 2007 case lapsed only after years; no effective remedy shown.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Custody placement for trans women is discretionary; the 2024 case's section is unrecorded, so birth-sex placement risk in a hostile prison is an open but serious question.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Documented: combined regime — nationwide secular criminalisation叠加 northern Sharia death-penalty provisions in all 12 provinces, an explicit inter-state severity gradient.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: A visitor's route through the north converts a 14-year custodial exposure into a potential capital one if same-sex conduct is alleged.

care_services.exposure: Documented indirectly: LGBTQ+ people fear seeking medical care due to arrest/extortion risk; community health work collapsed under the act. A visitor discovered as trans in care faces the same outing-to-officials channel.
care_services.protection: Not documented as operative. The constitution's nominal health guarantee sits alongside criminalisation and is not shown protecting trans visitors.
care_services.interaction: Emergency care → discovery → police referral; no documented safe pathway.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Documented: police as perpetrators — beating with a gun butt, extortion, torture, raids on private gatherings and hotels; press openly debated which section to keep 'the crossdresser' in; official misgendering of the killed trans woman.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Law and police aligned against the traveller: efficient enforcement of hostile rules is exposure, not recourse.

minors_guardians.exposure: Documented regime reaches a accompanying minor: a same-sex household or perceived conduct could expose parent and child to arrest; schools policy is resident-facing; mass raid patterns show group sweeps regardless of age-verification care.
minors_guardians.interaction: Child present during a stop or raid adds custody and welfare exposure with no documented child-protection buffer against the criminalisation regime.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Documented: attacks and extortion increased since 2014; dating-app luring gangs beat, film and blackmail using outing as leverage; a trans woman beaten to death (Aug 2024) with no charges six months on; a foreign advisory warns of attacks, blackmail and intimidation.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Not documented. Impunity for the 2024 killing is affirmatively negative evidence; community sting operations are self-help, not state protection.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police response documented as non-investigative, so street hostility and official indifference compound.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No legal protections for LGBTQ+ people; oversight panel reviewed only the bribery allegation, not placement policy; people fear reporting crimes.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Minor resident-facing positives only: a schools non-discrimination policy — inoperative for visitors.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unknowns (cross-dressing proposal status, prison section, prosecution frequency) all resolve structurally toward risk given documented hostile enforcement and absent recourse.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: routine state handling of document/appearance mismatch producing arrest, months of pretrial custody, abuse in custody, deferential courts and illusory remedies. Lower than 0.15-A only because no capital provision is shown applied to presentation cases — yet northern Sharia death penalties and a 2026 travel warning narrow that gap.

Materially lower. 0.55-B is administrative secondary screening with refused admission and return transport; here document friction feeds a documented chain of beating, extortion, mass raids and multi-year detention under criminal statute, with death-penalty risk in 12 provinces.

Far lower. 0.75-C assumes trained officers, brief detention, counsel, compensation and a working tribunal. This dossier documents the opposite at every node: police as perpetrators, impunity for a trans killing, no legal protections, and an advisory warning imprisonment and execution risk.

parsed.synthesis: The combined operative regime is criminalisation plus predation: nationwide secular law (10–14 years) overlaid with death-penalty Sharia provisions in all 12 northern provinces, enforced through police torture, extortion, and mass hotel raids with no prosecutions data and no protections. A trans visitor outed — at any stop, raid, app meeting, or medical encounter — enters this chain with no recourse: the one documented trans-specific killing went unprosecuted with official misgendering, and custody placement is discretionary and unrecorded. Resident-facing positives (schools policy, nominal health guarantee) do not reach travellers. Structural unknowns (cross-dressing proposal, prison section) resolve toward risk because documented enforcement is hostile and remedies are shown failing. Score sits with the 0.15 anchors: imprisonment highly likely after discovery, credible capital exposure in the north, but no documented execution of a trans person.
